items.title: Bijan Robinson: Solid production in Week 7 win
items.text:
Robinson rushed 20 times for 63 yards and brought in all five targets for 59 yards in the Falcons' 29-20 win over the 49ers on Sunday.

items.title: Derrick Henry: Shut down for second straight game
items.text:
Henry rushed 17 times for 45 yards and brought in one of two target for four yards in the Ravens' 35-13 loss to the Bengals on Sunday.

items.title: Justin Jefferson: Modest numbers in Week 7 win
items.text:
Jefferson caught four of seven targets for 44 yards in Sunday's 16-10 win over the Colts.

items.title: Joe Burrow: Dominant performance in second half
items.text:
Burrow completed 22 of 30 passes for 292 yards with four touchdowns and no interceptions while adding two rushes for 12 yards in the Bengals' 35-13 win over the Ravens on Sunday.

items.title: Zay Flowers: Stellar numbers in lopsided loss
items.text:
Flowers brought in eight of 11 targets for 137 yards and a touchdown in the Ravens' 35-13 loss to the Bengals on Sunday.
